text:
[Council File 26-1371; CD 10]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PLANNING AND LAND USE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE REPORT relative to waiving all of the current fees, charges, and accumulated interest associated with the property located at 2331 South 6th Avenue.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Hutt - Lee):
INSTRUCT and authorize the Department of Building and Safety to waive all of the current fees, charges, and accumulated interest associated with the property located at 2331 South 6th Avenue.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Motion asking Building and Safety to waive all current fees, charges and accumulated interest on the property at 2331 South 6th Avenue.
